terminals.name: mock-sentinel
terminals.description: Fake Flipkart Sentinel export service on :8081. Fault injection at POST /admin/fault/{id}, call counter at GET /admin/stats.
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"; until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -q; do sleep 1; done; exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn mock.sentinel_api:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8081

terminals.name: collector-api
terminals.description: Request API LiSN calls on :8080. POST /v1/collect, GET /v1/reconcile, /v1/dead-letter, /v1/health/detail.
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"; until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -q; do sleep 1; done; exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn collector.api:api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080

terminals.name: sentinel-worker
terminals.description: Procrastinate worker on the sentinel queue. -c 1 is load-bearing: one worker equals one connection to the source, which is what the rate arithmetic assumes.
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"; export PROCRASTINATE_APP=collector.app.app; until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -q; do sleep 1; done; exec .venv/bin/python -m procrastinate worker -q sentinel -c 1 --delete-jobs never

terminals.name: sentinel-discovery-worker
terminals.description: Procrastinate worker on the sentinel_discovery queue.
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"; export PROCRASTINATE_APP=collector.app.app; until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -q; do sleep 1; done; exec .venv/bin/python -m procrastinate worker -q sentinel_discovery -c 1 --delete-jobs never

terminals.name: maintenance-worker
terminals.description: Runs the periodic sweep (cron */2) and sweep_now. Required for any recovery or lease-expiry test.
terminals.command: set -a; source .env; set +a; export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"; export PROCRASTINATE_APP=collector.app.app; until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -q; do sleep 1; done; exec .venv/bin/python -m procrastinate worker -q maintenance -c 1 --delete-jobs never
